taxon_abundance.row_selection: All 440 species-level rows; source taxonomic hierarchy is retained in annotations.

functional_features.unit: HUMAnN pathway relative abundance (pathabundance_relab source scale)
functional_features.selection: 483 unstratified named pathways; taxon contributions and UNMAPPED/UNINTEGRATED excluded from this matrix.
functional_features.column_total: Less than one because special categories were excluded; see functional-denominators.tsv.
functional_features.meaning: DNA-based functional potential, not measured activity.
functional_features.normalization_in_legacy_workflow: Dividing by the named-pathway total produces a proportion within the supplied named pathway set, not a fraction of all microbial genes or functions.

inference_limits: Relative abundances must not be treated as original read counts.
Age, gender and BMI are not available in this pinned curated metadata.
Pathways can overlap; stacked proportions are not mutually exclusive biological allocations.
